user.title: Choose the passive RS485 connection
user.description: Choose a transparent RS485-over-TCP adapter or a USB-RS485 adapter connected directly to the Home Assistant host. Both modes are read-only.

tcp.title: Connect using RS485 over TCP
tcp.description: Enter the address of the adapter's raw TCP stream. The integration never sends requests or commands.

serial.title: Connect using USB-RS485
serial.description: Enter the stable device path, preferably /dev/serial/by-id/.... The port is opened read-only at 19200 8E1 and the integration never calls write().

error.cannot_connect: Connected, but no valid Dantherm RTU traffic was received.

init.title: Connection, calculation and filter warning
init.description: Change the connection, optionally select a weather entity as the outdoor temperature source, and configure the filter warning. The unit's outdoor-air sensor is used when this is empty.

data.filter_notify_days: Warn when this many days remain

error.cannot_connect: No valid Dantherm RTU traffic was received from the selected connection.

connection_lost.title: No connection to the RS485 gateway
connection_lost.description: Dantherm HCH PassiveLink has been unable to connect to the configured RS485 gateway for more than 15 minutes. Check the gateway's power, network connection, and that the transparent TCP stream is still active. Open the integration's options if the address has changed.

hac1_disconnected.title: HAC1 indoor-climate module not responding
hac1_disconnected.description: RS485 traffic from the Dantherm unit is still present, but the HAC1 module (CO2/indoor climate) has not reported itself as connected for more than 15 minutes. Check the HAC1 module's wiring and power.
